# implement-frontend

Implement FE TODOs one-at-a-time, ticking checkboxes and committing after each.

## Pre-conditions

- `ShopWeb/package.json` exists
- `ShopWeb/src/App.tsx` + `ShopWeb/src/lib/axios.ts` exist (bootstrap baseline)
- `TODO.md` exists with at least one unchecked `[FE]` task
- `DESIGN.md` exists with a "Frontend" or "UI" section

If pre-conditions fail, output what's missing and stop.

## Step 0 (BLOCKING) — Read CONTRACT.md before any feature work

`CONTRACT.md` is the source of truth for every endpoint shape, validation rule, and required header. It is generated by `scaffold-feature` after BE is done.

**Before writing any `api.ts`, `types.ts`, or `schemas.ts` for a feature:**

1. Open `CONTRACT.md` at workspace root. If it does not exist, STOP and request `scaffold-feature` to generate it.
2. Find the endpoint(s) the current TODO uses.
3. Copy field names **exactly** into `types.ts` (camelCase, same nullability as JSON example).
4. Translate every validation rule into a matching Zod rule in `schemas.ts`. If BE says `phone` must match `^0\d{9}$`, the Zod must say `.regex(/^0\d{9}$/, "Invalid Vietnamese phone")`. Same min/max, same required/optional. **No drift allowed** — a divergent rule is the #1 cause of 400 errors.
5. Use the `axios snippet` provided in CONTRACT.md as the starting point for `api.ts` — do not invent the URL or payload shape from memory.
6. If a payload includes nested objects (e.g. `{ customer: { email } }`), Zod schema MUST nest identically — DO NOT flatten.

**Hard rule:** if FE submits a body and BE returns 400, FE is wrong (either the schema diverged from CONTRACT.md, or the form sends fields the BE doesn't recognize). Fix Zod / `api.ts` against `CONTRACT.md`, never bypass with `// @ts-expect-error` or sending raw JSON.

## Inputs

- `CONTRACT.md` — **READ FIRST** (wire format, validation rules, axios snippets)
- `TODO.md` — list of FE TODOs (look for `[FE]` tag in the title)
- `DESIGN.md` — section "Frontend" / "UI" / "Pages" describes screens, routes, components
- `feature-specs/<name>.spec.md` — original acceptance criteria
- Existing `ShopWeb/src/` — extend, don't duplicate

## Feature-folder pattern (MUST follow)

Suggested split for **Shop Fullstack** spec — separate user + admin domains:

```
ShopWeb/src/features/
├── home/                          # USER: HomePage
│   ├── api.ts | hooks.ts          # featuredProducts query
│   ├── HeroBanner.tsx
│   └── CategoriesGrid.tsx
├── products/                      # USER + ADMIN: shared types/api

│   ├── ProductDetailPage.tsx
│   ├── CategoryPage.tsx

├── ErrorBoundary.tsx

```

For each feature folder, the file convention:

```
features/<feature>/
├─ api.ts            # axios calls + query keys (no UI here)
├─ hooks.ts          # useQuery / useMutation wrappers
├─ types.ts          # TS interfaces mirroring BE DTOs
├─ schemas.ts        # zod schemas for forms (if feature has forms)
├─ <Page>.tsx        # route-level page (composes feature components)
└─ components/       # feature-scoped components (1 file per component)
```

### `api.ts` shape

> Every function here MUST match an `axios snippet` block in `CONTRACT.md`. Do not invent URLs, params, or payload shapes — copy them.

```ts
import { api } from "@/lib/axios";
import type { Product, ProductSearchQuery, PagedResult } from "./types";

export const productKeys = {
  all: ["products"] as const,
  list: (q: ProductSearchQuery) => [...productKeys.all, "list", q] as const,
  detail: (id: string) => [...productKeys.all, "detail", id] as const,
};

export async function searchProducts(q: ProductSearchQuery): Promise<PagedResult<Product>> {
  const { data } = await api.get("/products/search", { params: q });
  return data;
}

export async function getProduct(id: string): Promise<Product> {
  const { data } = await api.get(`/products/${id}`);
  return data;
}
```

### Surfacing 400/422 to the user (no silent failures)

`@/lib/axios` already extracts `err.response?.data?.title`. For ProblemDetails validation errors, also surface field-level errors so the user sees what BE rejected:

```ts
// Extend axios interceptor in src/lib/axios.ts:
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (r) => r,
  (err) => {
    const data = err.response?.data;
    const fieldErrors = data?.errors as Record<string, string[]> | undefined;
    if (fieldErrors) {
      const first = Object.entries(fieldErrors)[0];
      return Promise.reject(new Error(`${first[0]}: ${first[1][0]}`));
    }
    return Promise.reject(new Error(data?.title ?? err.message));
  },
);
```

In mutation hooks, propagate to the form so the user sees BE's exact complaint instead of a generic toast:

```ts
const submit = useMutation({
  mutationFn: createOrder,
  onError: (e: Error) => {
    // e.g. "customer.email: 'customer.email' is not a valid email address."
    const m = /^(\S+?):\s*(.+)$/.exec(e.message);
    if (m) form.setError(m[1] as any, { message: m[2] });
    else toast.error(e.message);
  },
});
```

### `hooks.ts` shape

```ts
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { productKeys, searchProducts, getProduct } from "./api";

export function useProducts(q: ProductSearchQuery) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: productKeys.list(q),
    queryFn: () => searchProducts(q),
    placeholderData: (prev) => prev,
  });
}

export function useProduct(id: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: productKeys.detail(id),
    queryFn: () => getProduct(id),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
}
```

### Form pattern (react-hook-form + zod)

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { z } from "zod";

const schema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(1, "Required"),
  email: z.string().email("Invalid email"),
});
type FormValues = z.infer<typeof schema>;

export function CheckoutForm({ onSubmit }: { onSubmit: (v: FormValues) => void }) {
  const form = useForm<FormValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), mode: "onBlur" });
  return (
    <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
      {/* Use shadcn <Form>, <FormField>, <FormItem>, <FormLabel>, <FormControl>, <FormMessage> */}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Workflow per TODO

```
1. Find first unchecked [FE] task in TODO.md
2. Read DESIGN.md → relevant section
3. Plan files to create / modify (1 task usually = 1-3 files)
4. Implement:
   - If new feature folder → create api.ts, hooks.ts, types.ts first
   - Then page / components
   - Compose shadcn primitives (NEVER edit components/ui/)
5. Update router in App.tsx if new route
6. Run `npm run build` → fix TS errors
7. Tick checkbox in TODO.md
8. Commit: "[ai] feat: T<N>-FE <description>"
9. Next TODO
```

## shadcn component usage cheatsheet

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Action button | `<Button>` from `@/components/ui/button` |
| Form input | `<Input>` + `<Label>` + `<FormMessage>` |
| Card layout | `<Card>` + `<CardHeader>` + `<CardContent>` + `<CardFooter>` |
| Dropdown | `<DropdownMenu>` family |
| Modal | `<Dialog>` family — not `<Sheet>` (Sheet = side drawer) |
| Side drawer (cart) | `<Sheet>` |
| Select | `<Select>` family — never native `<select>` |
| Toast | `toast.success("...")` / `toast.error("...")` from `sonner` |
| Loading skeleton | `<Skeleton>` |
| Table | `<Table>` family |
| Badge | `<Badge>` (e.g. category tag, stock count) |
| Empty state | Compose: icon + `<h3>` + `<p>` + optional `<Button>` |
| Product image gallery | Compose: primary `<img>` large (aspect-square) + thumbnail strip below (4 small `<img>` clickable to swap primary) |

## Image rendering convention (Shop fullstack)

- BE seeds images via Unsplash Source API (real photos by keyword): `https://source.unsplash.com/600x600/?{keywords}&sig=...`
- FE MUST use `<SafeImage>` wrapper everywhere (never raw `<img>` for product images) — handles error fallback to placeholder
- Product card (list): use `product.primaryImageUrl` (BE convenience field), fallback `images[0]?.url`
- Product detail: `<ProductGallery images={product.images} />` — primary large + thumbnail strip + keyboard arrow nav
- Always `alt={img.altText ?? product.name}`
- Use `<Skeleton className="aspect-square">` while loading

### `<SafeImage>` component — REQUIRED (place in `src/components/SafeImage.tsx`)

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface SafeImageProps extends React.ImgHTMLAttributes<HTMLImageElement> {
  fallbackText?: string;
}

export function SafeImage({ src, alt, className, fallbackText, ...rest }: SafeImageProps) {
  const [errored, setErrored] = useState(false);
  const fallback = `https://placehold.co/600x600/eee/666?text=${encodeURIComponent(fallbackText ?? alt ?? "image")}`;
  return (
    <img
      src={errored ? fallback : src}
      alt={alt}
      loading="lazy"
      decoding="async"
      onError={() => setErrored(true)}
      className={cn("object-cover", className)}
      {...rest}
    />
  );
}
```

Use:
```tsx
<SafeImage
  src={product.primaryImageUrl ?? product.images[0]?.url}
  alt={product.name}
  fallbackText={product.name}
  className="aspect-square w-full rounded-t-xl hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200"
/>
```

## UI Quality checklist (apply EVERY page)

Before committing a `[FE]` TODO, verify:

- [ ] **Typography:** Inter font, headings có `tracking-tight`, body line-height 1.5
- [ ] **Spacing:** Section `py-12 md:py-16`, cards `p-4 md:p-6`, gap-4 between items
- [ ] **Colors:** Only semantic tokens (`text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `bg-background`, `border`) + brand accents
- [ ] **Hover states:** All clickable elements có `transition-colors hover:...`
- [ ] **Product cards:** `hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200`
- [ ] **Image:** Only via `<SafeImage>`, aspect-square, `object-cover`
- [ ] **Skeleton:** Shape match real component (same aspect, same spacing)
- [ ] **Empty state:** `<EmptyState>` composed component (icon + heading + desc + optional CTA)
- [ ] **Toasts:** Sonner with semantic variant (success/error/info)
- [ ] **Loading button:** `disabled + opacity-50 + spinner` when isSubmitting
- [ ] **Dark mode:** Toggle works on this page, no white flash
- [ ] **Mobile:** Tested at 375px width (iPhone SE), no h-scroll, touch ≥ 44px

### `<EmptyState>` component — REQUIRED (place in `src/components/EmptyState.tsx`)

```tsx
import { type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface EmptyStateProps {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  cta?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
}

export function EmptyState({ icon: Icon, title, description, cta }: EmptyStateProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
      <Icon className="size-12 text-muted-foreground mb-4" />
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h3>
      {description && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-sm">{description}</p>}
      {cta && <Button onClick={cta.onClick} className="mt-6">{cta.label}</Button>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility checklist (per page)

- All interactive elements reachable via Tab
- Icon-only buttons have `aria-label`
- Form errors announce via `<FormMessage>` (shadcn handles this)
- Headings hierarchical (one `<h1>` per page)
- Color contrast ≥ AA (use `text-muted-foreground` not `text-gray-300`)

```markdown
## ✅ T<N>-FE completed: <one-line>

**Files changed:**

- `ShopWeb/src/features/products/ProductList.tsx` (created)

**Type-check:** OK (0 errors)
**Commit:** `[ai] feat: T<N>-FE <description>`

```

## Triggers

- "/implement-frontend"
- "implement FE TODOs"
- "build the UI for this feature"
- As Phase 3b of `deliver-feature`

## Don't

- Don't edit `ShopWeb/src/components/ui/*` (vendored shadcn — re-add via CLI if needed)
- Don't introduce new global state libs (no Zustand/Redux without architect approval)
- Don't use `useEffect` for data fetching (use TanStack Query)
- Don't import from `@radix-ui/*` directly — go through shadcn wrappers
- Don't write CSS files — use Tailwind utilities
- Don't pixel-push (`px-[13px]`) without reason — stick to spacing scale
- Don't merge multiple TODOs into one commit

## Self-heal (autonomous mode)

After each TODO: if `npm run build` fails with TS error → read TS#### → fix type, prop, import → rebuild (max 2 retries per TODO). If shadcn primitive missing → re-add via `npx shadcn add <name> -y`. If import path errors → check `tsconfig.json` paths alias. NEVER `// @ts-ignore` to bypass — fix the type. See `deliver-feature/SKILL.md` Autonomous Mode.
